data.SimulationQueue
public class SimulationQueue <<<<<<< HEAD extends Object
A thread-safe communication channel between the Simulation Thread (Producer) and the JavaFX UI Thread (Consumer).

This class implements the Producer-Consumer design pattern using a BlockingQueue. It ensures that the heavy calculations performed by SUMO do not freeze the User Interface by buffering the results in a thread-safe manner.

      public data.SimulationState pollState() throws InterruptedException
      Retrieves and removes the head of this queue, or returns null if this queue is empty.

      Usage: This method is called by the JavaFX AnimationTimer (Consumer). It is non-blocking to ensure the UI never freezes, even if the simulation loop is running slower than the frame rate.

      Returns:
      The next SimulationState object, or null if the queue is empty.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - if the thread is interrupted.
